outcome: prenatal diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
cohort: The study included a training cohort of 111 pregnant patients (72 with PAS and 39 without) and a validation cohort of 47 pregnant patients (33 with PAS and 14 without).
finding: The Nomogram model, integrating Radscore, a clinical indicator, and MRI signs, demonstrated superior performance (AUC of 0.861) with high sensitivity (81.8%) and specificity (78.6%) for prenatal diagnosis of placenta accreta spectrum.
